spec.definition:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Inventory API
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /items/{itemId}/availability:
    get:
      operationId: getItemAvailability
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Current available quantity
  /reservations:
    post:
      operationId: createReservation
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Reservation created
  /admin/items:
    post:
      operationId: createInventoryItem
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Item created

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Fulfillment API
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /fulfillment-tasks:
    post:
      operationId: createFulfillmentTask
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Task created
  /fulfillment-tasks/{taskId}:
    get:
      operationId: getFulfillmentTask
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Task state

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Donor Directory API
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /donors/{donorId}:
    get:
      operationId: getDonor
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Donor record
  /donors/search:
    post:
      operationId: searchDonors
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Matching donors
